description: This file defines an interface 'IQueueFlowController' within the Orleans.Streams namespace, which provides a method for managing the flow control of queue items, specifically to retrieve the maximum number of items that can be added to the queue.

classes.name: IQueueFlowController
classes.description: Interface for controlling the flow of retrieved queue items, providing a method to get the maximum number of items that can be added.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added to the queue.
